runs.review_notes: Reviewed BatchInsertReservations:13-26, helper:3-32 and table:1-18. Correct all four positional bindings, indirect INSERT and cycling quantity, per-loop transaction and exact -1 rollback guard/rethrow. Correctly excludes commented native helper/table alternatives and separates deployment unknowns.

Reviewed CalculateCustomerPrice:26-85. Correct deterministic 30.00 result and exact percentage expression; explicit minimum and largest fixed discount compete against base without stacking; percentage compares to current price. Bug label is interpretation of naming/intent, not treated as an additional sourced requirement.

Reviewed 2 json.sql:53-66,84,112-134. All three required JSON operations correct. However it positively asserts product 16 prior values and continued promo matching from a later sample array, which does not establish the actual pre-UPDATE table state; closing unknown caveat contradicts those assertions. Line 84 supports the literal only, not the claimed prior row value.

Reviewed both usp_FulfillOrders bodies. Correct one-selection versus ten-iteration code, native/owner/schema/SNAPSHOT declarations, writes and stale SELECT assignment warning. Omits exact 1900-01-01 sentinel and does not fully state the guard for both variants. Extra claims that loop is unbounded, native always owns a separate transaction, and no transitive effects follow from these body files are unsupported/overstated; counter still bounds loop at ten and ambient effects are unknown.

Reviewed exact static calls InsertCustomerOrders:44/CreateCustomerOrders:98; configuration strings Enable:420-485 and Disable:399-464. Correct two static callers, excludes declaration, and distinguishes installing a procedure definition from immediately executing its body. Context/execution citations match.

Reviewed dispatcher:31-33 and helper:14-32, plus TransactionID definition. Correct three named bindings, sys.sequences schema filter, temp MAX/COALESCE, >= guard/max+1 and runtime uncertainty. Omits QUOTENAME identifier protection (partial criterion 3, not double-penalized). Parenthetical last call wins/final value maximum assertion overstates the guarded calls: a later lower maximum leaves sequence untouched.

Reviewed setup:93-114 and seed:38-45, example:28-31. Correct ProductID/payload, NULL Color/Size, ISNULL preservation Data/Tags, CompanyID not assigned, strict Name/Price. Seed examples are explicitly distinguished from unknown deployed pre-values; no case-insensitivity or no-downstream-effects claim.

Reviewed dispatcher:31-33/helper:14-32 and TransactionID seed. Correct bindings, metadata/temp max, >= guarded max+1, unchanged-when-ahead and live-value uncertainty. Omits QUOTENAME (partial third criterion only). Final maximum description is explicitly conditional on exceeding running value; no numeric runtime answer invented.

Reviewed both ticket procedure bodies and disk table/sequence definitions. Correct bindings, indirect INSERT and quantity loop, caller sequence/transaction and precise -1 rollback predicate, interpreted active helper versus commented native alternative. Correctly notes possible committable transaction path and ultimately states post-THROW increment is unreachable on propagated error.

Reviewed setup:93-114 and json example:28-31. All requested target/payload, omitted-property assignments/preservation and strict path facts correct. Distinguishes unknown trigger/runtime state rather than asserting absent indirect effects. No claim that lax matching ignores case.

Reviewed order body:13-64/function:21-85. Correct two direct INSERTs, local variable and four pricing read targets; lists sequence/BEGIN/COMMIT/catch but omits unreachable RETURN -1 distinction. Incorrect extra claim that pricing reads Sales.BuyingGroups and Sales.CustomerCategories; it only reads their IDs from Customers. Sequence consumption is not an in-memory sequence/local-only effect. Function:44 citation does not support caller TaxRate/UnitPackageID reads (caller:43-45 does).

Reviewed two static call sites and complete Enable:420-485/Disable:399-464 dynamic definition boundaries. All caller classification/citations correct, declaration excluded. Extra assertion that these embedded InsertCustomerOrders definitions are natively compiled/memory optimized is false: their shown WITH clause is EXECUTE AS OWNER without NATIVE_COMPILATION.

Reviewed SqlClrCurl:43-60 and trust-assembly section. Correct XGET types/return/external target, XPOST parameters/target, EXTERNAL_ACCESS and unknown headers/table effects. XPOST described as returns nothing rather than absence of declared scalar return type; SQL procedure declaration does not establish absence of result/return behavior. Extra parameter names are positional not named assertion contradicts declared SQL parameter names.

Reviewed full login/password procedures and People FullName declaration. Correct predicates, SHA2_256 password+FullName, person-1 template/exclusion, zero-row THROW and unreachable RETURN. Template criterion partial because activation LogonName assignment/enabling are not actually explained (only ChangePassword enabling is stated). Success has no explicit RETURN, correctly distinguished.

Reviewed sensor body:2-50, SensorDataList type and ColdRoomTemperatures schema. Correct MIN/MAX loop, sensor UPDATE/rowcount INSERT, native/schema/ATOMIC SNAPSHOT, fixed THROW and unreachable RETURN. Shows final 2 in THROW but does not identify it as state (partial fourth criterion). Extra decimal(18,2) to decimal(10,2) conversion called benign despite possible out-of-range input/overflow; source does not establish that guarantee.

Reviewed invoice:22-150. All eligibility, fail-before-BEGIN, five writes, grouped holdings reduction/negative stock quantities correct; explicitly accounts for consumed sequence values. Extra no-trigger assertion unsupported: transcript only greps two table-definition files for TRIGGER, which cannot exclude separately defined triggers. Reviewed both full fulfillment bodies. Correct one selection versus ten-counter loop, direct tables/guards and native/owner/schema/ATOMIC SNAPSHOT declarations. Omits exact sentinel. Misses stale SELECT variable retention, instead suggests trailing no-match iterations necessarily spin without work. Extra claim native SNAPSHOT requires MEMORY_OPTIMIZED_ELEVATE_TO_SNAPSHOT or hints is incorrect, and unconditional implicitly-committed own transaction is overstated. Disk result SELECT is line 44, not claimed 49.

Reviewed pricing:26-85. Correct 30.00 arithmetic/exact ROUND formula, minimum explicit price and maximum fixed discount based on original price, lower-current comparison including percentage. Does not stack discounts. Bug/well-known wording is interpretation/popularity, not counted as a material extra SQL behavior claim.
